run_googletest_output_test: run the googletest output test to verify Google Test text output matches the golden file
generate_golden_file: generate a new golden file by running all gtest commands with the --gengolden flag
normalize_test_output: normalize googletest output by removing file locations, stack traces, and time information
remove_matching_tests: remove output of specified test cases from googletest output using a regex pattern
remove_unsupported_tests: remove unsupported test output like death tests or typed tests based on platform capabilities
